title: Planning Goal Key
description: The planning goals a seller can evaluate and report on. Each value names the criteria.planning_goals property it reports on (spot_length_mix, max_spots_per_hour, overbook_percentage, daypart_mix and pacing sit under delivery_rules), except max_cost, which reports on delivery_target.max_cost. budget_mode and audience_basis are inputs rather than goals and have no key.

enumDescriptions.objective: planning_goals.objective. Reported met when the plan is the seller's best attempt at the objective within the other goals, with the achieved figure (reach or CPP/CPM) in `achieved`.
enumDescriptions.delivery_target: planning_goals.delivery_target.value. target and achieved are in delivery_target.metric (GRPs or impressions).
enumDescriptions.max_cost: planning_goals.delivery_target.max_cost. target and achieved are cost per point (metric grps) or per thousand impressions (metric impressions), in the plan currency.
enumDescriptions.max_frequency: planning_goals.max_frequency. target and achieved are average exposures per person over max_frequency.window.
enumDescriptions.spot_length_mix: planning_goals.delivery_rules.spot_length_mix. No single figure: detail states the planned mix.
enumDescriptions.max_spots_per_hour: planning_goals.delivery_rules.max_spots_per_hour. achieved is the highest planned count in any station-hour.
enumDescriptions.overbook_percentage: planning_goals.delivery_rules.overbook_percentage. achieved is the planned overbook percentage.
enumDescriptions.daypart_mix: planning_goals.delivery_rules.daypart_mix. No single figure: detail states the planned shares.
enumDescriptions.must_include: planning_goals.must_include. unmet_items names what the plan omits.
enumDescriptions.must_exclude: planning_goals.must_exclude. unmet_items names what the plan still contains.
